news.headline: BofA adds January Fed hike to forecast, says quarterly pace no longer enough
news.summary: BofA Global Research anticipates that the Federal Reserve will implement a rate hike in January 2027. This adjustment follows the unexpectedly high Consumer Price Index report for October. Expectations of a 25-basis-point increase are supported by increasing inflation driven by various factors. Other banks like Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank have also revised their forecasts in light of recent data.

news.headline: German yields set for biggest weekly rise in two months
news.summary: As traders ramp up their expectations for European Central Bank interest rate hikes, yields on German government bonds are climbing steadily. This shift follows US inflation figures that were unexpectedly high, disrupting the bond market landscape. Meanwhile, global stock indices are witnessing a downturn, impacting the demand for traditionally safe assets.

news.headline: India 10-year bond yield reverses half of last week's drop on elevated inflation
news.summary: Indian government bonds fell for a third consecutive session, driven by inflation and interest-rate outlook concerns. The benchmark yield increased to 7.3079%, reversing much of last week's gains. Retail inflation in India accelerated, surpassing the Reserve Bank of India's target range, which raises rate hike expectations. In the US, rising Treasury yields and inflation data led to altered rate hike projections.

news.headline: Razorpay, Sembcorp Green Infra get Sebi nod to float IPOs
news.summary: Razorpay Software Ltd and Sembcorp Green Infra recently received approval from Sebi for their initial public offerings, marking a major milestone in their growth journeys. Razorpay aims to secure Rs 5,000-6,000 crore to enhance its financial services platform, while Sembcorp Green Infra plans to raise Rs 3,750 crore to bolster its renewable energy initiatives.

news.headline: India bonds under pressure before debt supply; hot inflation prints pinch further
news.summary: Indian government bonds experienced significant selling pressure ahead of a major auction for the benchmark paper. The yield on the 6.94% 2036 bond rose notably due to rising inflation in both India and the United States. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to raise interest rates again in early December due to persistent inflationary pressures. Moreover, US Treasury yields remained elevated as markets anticipate larger interest rate hikes.

news.headline: Anthropic IPO share orders from China are said to be rebuffed
news.summary: Investors based in mainland China and Hong Kong are excluded from placing orders in Anthropic's IPO. This decision reflects the strategic sensitivities between Washington and Beijing regarding technology advancements. Some investors are exploring alternative methods to participate in the public offering through offshore structures. Anthropic intends to complete its IPO on November 18, pricing the shares ahead of trading the next day.

news.headline: MAN Industries PAT rises to Rs 82 cr in Q2
news.summary: MAN Industries (India) Ltd has announced a substantial increase in consolidated profit after tax during the September quarter. The company's revenue from operations also saw a notable rise year-on-year, reflecting strong performance. The acquisition of National Pipe Company has positively impacted scale and profitability for the firm. Shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz temporarily affected revenue but shipments are being executed.

news.headline: Indian rupee snaps rising streak on hawkish Fed, oil rise
news.summary: In the past week, the Indian rupee faced downward pressure due to escalating oil prices. Although foreign investments offered some relief, they were insufficient to trigger a notable rebound. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to step in to boost forex reserves when the rupee shows strength. Furthermore, India's trade deficit in merchandise hit a yearly peak, compounding the rupee's challenges.

news.headline: Cisco shares rally after earnings beat: 6 key things investors need to know
news.summary: Cisco shares surge after strong Q1 FY2027 results, beating analyst estimates. Robust AI data-centre demand drives revenue growth, prompting the networking giant to raise its annual revenue and earnings forecasts.

news.headline: Carlsberg said to start road show for $600 million India IPO
news.summary: Carlsberg is preparing a potential $600 million IPO of its Indian business, targeting a $4 billion valuation. The offering could launch as early as January 2027, comprising a 15% stake sale by its Danish parent. Strong IPO demand in India supports the listing outlook, with Carlsberg India reporting robust revenue.

news.headline: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee says on CNBC the Fed needs to guard against demand overheating
news.summary: Chicago Fed president Austan Goolsbee stated that inflation has moved beyond temporary energy and tariff-related price shocks. He highlighted that increased demand from the AI buildout is pushing prices higher across many sectors including health care and services. Goolsbee emphasized the importance of upcoming inflation data for determining the Fed's rate increase pace. He noted that currently, there is no clear path back to the 2% inflation target.

news.headline: S&P 500, Nasdaq close lower as rate-hike bets pressure US stocks: Stock Market Highlights
How US tech pain is European stock markets' gain
news.summary: European stock markets, particularly the STOXX 600, are performing well as tech turmoil affects global markets. This relative stability is attributed to Europe's lower exposure to tech giants compared to the US market. Companies in sectors such as energy and financials are supporting earnings growth, which is on track for 25% quarterly profit. Investors remain cautious, noting that broader market selloffs could still impact Europe.

news.headline: Jagatjit Industries Q2 net loss narrows to Rs 4 cr, revenue rises 90%
news.summary: Jagatjit Industries Ltd has reported a net loss of Rs 3.96 crore for the second quarter of FY27, significantly improving from Rs 27.91 crore lost during the same period last year. Total income surged to Rs 195.43 crore, up from Rs 103.11 crore. In the first half of FY27, the company posted an overall net loss of Rs 12.23 crore, a decrease from Rs 37.81 crore.

news.headline: Tesla-SpaceX Merger: Musk eyes December deal announcement
news.summary: Tesla and SpaceX are reportedly advancing merger talks, with a potential December announcement. The proposed $3.5 trillion-plus deal could unite their AI, robotics, automotive and aerospace businesses.
